user.description: Play Hue scenes, the standard whites and the dynamic palettes, on lamps paired to ZHA. Zones and palettes are set up in the options afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.
abort.zha_not_ready: ZHA is not running. Set up ZHA first.

data_description.colors: 2 to 9 colours as hex RGB, separated by commas, for example #ff8800, #ffd000, #00a0ff.
data_description.speed: How fast the lamps move through the colours. Hue scenes use about 0.63.

data_description.colors: 2 to 9 colours as hex RGB, separated by commas, for example #ff8800, #ffd000, #00a0ff.
data_description.speed: How fast the lamps move through the colours. Hue scenes use about 0.63.

add_zone.title: Add a zone
add_zone.description: A zone is a ZHA group whose lamps start a palette together, or a single ZHA light.

data_description.light: The light of a ZHA group, or a single light.

zone.title: Zone {zone}
zone.description:
Clusters (lamps that start with the same colour):
{clusters}

zone_palettes.title: Palettes of the zone
zone_palettes.description: The zone always offers the standard scenes, plus a scene per chosen palette. Palettes are optional.

add_cluster.title: Add a cluster
add_cluster.description: Lamps in a cluster start with the same colour and stay in sync, for example a pair of lamps on both sides of a door.

lamp_correction.title: Lamp correction
lamp_correction.description: Some LED controllers show warm whites colder than set. A correction makes the standard scenes use warmer settings on such a light.

warmest_white.title: Lamp correction
warmest_white.description: Enter the warmest white {light} really shows, from {min} K to {max} K. Leave it empty to remove the correction.

error.name_taken: A standard scene or another palette already has this name.
error.invalid_colors: Enter 2 to 9 colours as hex RGB, for example #ff8800.
error.cluster_too_small: A cluster needs at least two lights.
error.invalid_warmest_white: Enter a value from the range above.

abort.no_lights: There are no ZHA groups or lights left to add.
abort.no_color_temperature_lights: There are no ZHA lights with colour temperature.

activate.name: Activate
activate.description: Starts a scene on its zone, optionally with another brightness or transition, and a palette with another speed.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Animation speed of a palette from 0 to 1 instead of its own.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness from 1 to 255 for all lamps instead of the scene's.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Duration of the transition to the scene.

rewrite_scenes.name: Rewrite scenes
rewrite_scenes.description: Writes the zone's scenes to the lamps again, each on its next activation. Use it when scenes were removed from the lamps by other means.
